resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO or GPAW (open-source DFT with PAW, GGA-PBE)

access.notes: Any open-source DFT code supporting PAW and spin-polarised GGA-PBE can be used. GPAW also acceptable (https://wiki.fysik.dtu.dk/gpaw/).

resources.name: PAW pseudopotentials for Fe, B, C, N, O (PBE, without semicore for Fe, 2s2p for solutes)

access.notes: Standard PBE PAW datasets from PseudoDojo, SSSP (https://www.materialscloud.org/discover/sssp), or GPAW setups. Must match the paper’s valence treatment (no semicore for Fe, 2s2p for B/C/N/O).
Helpful for building and manipulating atomistic structures.
